H2b PASS: cheap tier crosses $50 breakeven on 100/100 = 100.0% of cells (esc_cost_per_lift = $0.01 << $50). H3 PARTIAL: 5-seed CV on value_rate ≤ 0.20 on 50/100 = 50.0% of cells (bar 80%); the escalation decision (does LLM add value?) is robust -- n_lift > 0 on all 500 cells.
